errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of classes across a multi-task benchmark for abusive language detection. The chart is composed of fifteen slices, each representing a different category of text.
errors.evidence: The figure is a hierarchical sunburst chart (or multi-level pie chart), not a simple pie chart with fifteen slices. The description fails to identify the multiple rings and the hierarchical relationships between the categories, which is the fundamental structure of the visualization.

errors.text_span: The largest slice, colored orange, is labeled “Positive” and appears to occupy approximately 30% of the total area.
errors.evidence: This is completely incorrect. The chart is primarily divided into "Abusive" (teal) and "Not Abusive" (orange/yellow), each taking up roughly 50%. "Positive" is not a single slice, but a label that appears on several smaller segments in the outermost ring. The description misidentifies the segment, its label, its color grouping, and its size.

errors.text_span: Following this is a slice labeled “Neutral,” colored beige, which accounts for approximately 20%.
errors.evidence: "Neutral" is not a single slice accounting for 20%. It is a label that appears on multiple smaller segments in the outermost ring.

errors.text_span: The next largest segment, colored teal, is labeled “Negative,” representing approximately 18%.
errors.evidence: The teal color corresponds to the entire "Abusive" category, which is approximately 50% of the chart. "Negative" is not a single slice but a label that appears on multiple segments in the outer ring.
The description incorrectly identifies "TiALD" as a slice. "TiALD" is a label in the hollow center of the chart, not a data-representing slice.

errors.text_span: A legend is provided to delineate the colors associated with each category.
errors.evidence: There is no legend in the figure. All categories are labeled directly on the chart segments.

errors.text_span: The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest, moving clockwise from the “Positive” slice.
errors.evidence: The segments of the chart are not ordered by size in any discernible way. This is an invented feature that is not present in the visualization.
